name: next_code_point_reverse
declaration: unsafe fn next_code_point_reverse < 'a , I > (bytes : & mut I) -> Option < u32 > where I : DoubleEndedIterator < Item = & 'a u8 > ,
documentation:
Reads the last code point out of a byte iterator (assuming a
 UTF-8-like encoding).

 # Safety

 `bytes` must produce a valid UTF-8-like (UTF-8 or WTF-8) string
rules: For safety, `bytes` must produce a valid UTF-8-like string, meaning a valid UTF-8 or WTF-8 string.
